title_en: Psychology Made Simple (13/20): Just Five More Minutes on My Phone
note_en: 她越不想做，心里就越着急，而越着急，就越想拿起手机 chains two rounds of 越…就越…: "the less she wants to do it, the more anxious she gets, and the more anxious she gets, the more she wants her phone." Notice that Chinese has no "less": "the less she wants" is 越不想 "the more she doesn't want." Each 越 sits right before the verb or adjective, and the subject can be dropped in the second round.
